note: Voice round script. The SAME lines are read by macOS say voices (AI clips, npm run asli:voices) and by Zenith students (real clips, see inbox/README.md). Max about 4 seconds each. The Curator never puts two clips of the same line in one game.

lines.text: Hi! I just built my first chatbot, and it actually works.
Welcome to Ideas four point oh. Come play with us!
My favourite subject is maths. Don't tell anyone.
The canteen chai today was really good.
Can you guess if this voice is real or AI?
Our robot team meets every Friday after class.
आज कैंटीन में समोसे बहुत अच्छे थे।
lines.roman: Aaj canteen mein samose bahut achchhe the.

lines.text: मेरा पहला प्रोजेक्ट एक छोटा सा रोबोट था।
lines.roman: Mera pehla project ek chhota sa robot tha.

lines.text: चलो, आज लाइब्रेरी में साथ पढ़ते हैं।
lines.roman: Chalo, aaj library mein saath padhte hain.

lines.text: क्या तुम बता सकते हो कि यह आवाज़ असली है?
lines.roman: Kya tum bata sakte ho ki yeh awaaz asli hai?
